description: An extremely fast Python linter and code formatter, written in Rust.
vibe: Deep invariant verification, strict typing, and defensive boundary guarantees.
highlights: This repository contains both Ruff (a Python linter and formatter) and ty (a Python type checker). The crates follow a naming convention: `ruff_*` for Ruff-specific code and `ty_*` for ty-specific code. ty reuses several Ruff crates, including the Python parser (`ruff_python_parser`) and AST definitions (`ruff_python_ast`).
